active_definition: Y functionally active; N dormant, not disincorporated, still counted in the Census inventory.
geography_definition: Directory county may be the most-served area or headquarters county; it is not a full service-area boundary. Place components apply to general-purpose units only. No semantic or directory-component join automatically assigns finance or beneficiary locations.
excluded_fields: Contact titles, addresses, postal codes, websites, population and enrollment fields are excluded.
